pinned_implementation.operator_order: raw.float(); mean_squared=raw.pow(2).mean(-1,keepdim=True)+eps; q=torch.pow(mean_squared,-0.5); (raw*q)*weight.float(); cast back to raw dtype. Direct gamma,not 1+gamma.

sources.implication: RMS normalization and its shared rescaling property are established. Retain epsilon and native operator order;do not call this a new method.

design_resolution: Use one site at a time under exactly the same native input at that site. Joint all-layer source-state recombination could mix upstream paths and is not the local factorization. Keep every one of the nine layers present in all three fixed groups,without selecting a winning site.
scope: A native-state control assay,not an explanation of N41 regressions,utility confirmation or individual meaning. No task text,answers or raw private states were sent to external sources.
